title: Alinear fast allocation con barreras de contención explícitas
mission: Make the current /wc fast-allocation path honor explicit contention-barrier metadata before any portfolio PIN attempt. Barrier-enabled multi-party canary jobs must allocate a timing-only entrant/rendezvous action first, wait only within the bounded barrier contract, then race the ordinary deterministic PIN after a valid RELEASE. Ordinary portfolio jobs must remain direct-to-PIN. Do not hardcode fixture job IDs and do not promote production /w.
definition_of_done: The fast allocator exposes an explicit machine-readable pre-PIN barrier/rendezvous action for jobs whose durable metadata opts into contention_barrier_mode; it does not emit PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE before RELEASE for those jobs.
Entrant and RELEASE receipts remain timing-only and never grant execution authority; the deterministic PIN remains the sole portfolio execution authority primitive.
The /wc fast-allocation/bootstrap contract can consume the barrier action without broad preclaim archaeology or human synchronization.
After a valid RELEASE, distinct entrants race the exact same deterministic PIN generation and losers persist normal collision receipts with no execution claim.
Barrier timeout produces no PIN attempt and routes the worker back to allocation.
Ordinary jobs without explicit barrier metadata preserve the current direct PORTFOLIO_PIN_CREATE path.
Regression fixtures cover at least explicit 2-worker and 5-worker barrier routing plus ordinary-job backward compatibility.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
